name: Night Sky Elixir (Moderate)

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
Silver shavings, purified through secret alchemical processes, gleam like a starry night sky suspended in this thick black oil, which grants some of silver's protection against devils. For 1 hour, you gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against effects created by devils and divine spells cast by devils.

Effect: Night Sky Elixir (Moderate)
